market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near records after a recent Fed rate hike, while Brent crude remained near $100 amid Iran-war uncertainty; Wednesday's 9:45 a.m. ET flash PMIs arrive after the covered pre-market releases.

methodology.disparity_definition: 70% weight to average pairwise direction-score distance normalized to 0-100, plus 30% weight to average pairwise reversal-risk distance; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied hard timing confirmation, decisive-KPI framing, priced-in penalties, forward-look checks and low-bar reversal floors. No new method change was warranted.

ranked_companies.timing: Sep. 23, 2026 before market open (release expected before 9:30 a.m. ET call)
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic Management Solutions growth; 44% margin path
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Paycor cross-sell, bookings and margin execution support modest upside if organic payroll growth remains visible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.32-$1.35 EPS on roughly $1.6-$1.66B revenue; FY27 guidance calls for 5%-6% revenue growth and about 44% adjusted margin.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic bookings and PEO worksite growth validate the 7%-9% EPS-growth guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Integration benefits mask weak small-business hiring or management trims the outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Current options sources place the implied move near 7.6%, above the stock's typical earnings reaction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus implies roughly 9% EPS growth; published previews emphasize bookings, pricing, PEO momentum and Paycor synergies.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Three Lean Up calls; very low disparity.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Prior miss and weak JV mix

ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.75-$0.77 adjusted EPS and $331-$335M revenue, versus $0.74 EPS a year ago; only two estimates underpin the consensus.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Data-center shipments, Elgen/LSI integration and JV earnings beat a reset bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ClarkDietrich weakness and acquisition mix produce another revenue or EPS miss.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One event source estimated about 5%, below the roughly 8.3% average realized move; treat it as approximate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is thin; the narrow $0.75-$0.77 EPS range provides limited revision breadth.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Three Lean Up calls; very low disparity.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High-single-digit organic growth and record margins favor another beat, but valuation makes merely in-line execution vulnerable.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic growth stays near 8% and margin exceeds consensus without weakening the guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth or margin normalizes, or UniFirst regulatory and financing costs cloud the forward view.

ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Three Lean Up calls; low disparity.

ranked_companies.company: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc.
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Rally and turnaround optimism raise bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A July business update de-risked the quarter, but the reaction now depends on whether new management can guide to durable traffic and EBITDA recovery.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.16 EPS and $845.6M revenue; July commentary said revenue should reach or exceed the prior high end and adjusted EBITDA should exceed guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Traffic improves from the reported -2.5% trend and FY27 margins benefit from divestiture and cost actions.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: New guidance reveals weak traffic durability, rent burden or transition disruption.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 15.2%, about twice the ten-year average move, signaling unusually high event uncertainty.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Targets rose after Q3 and the July update, but ratings remain split from Sell to Overweight.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Three Lean Up calls; low disparity but uniformly elevated reversal risk.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Repeated low-bar turnaround reversal floor applied.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Net orders and adjusted housing gross margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar plus buybacks can spark relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak orders and backlog plus rate pressure lean down unless the promised sequential margin recovery and order stabilization are clear.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.89-$0.90 EPS and $1.30-$1.31B revenue, inside management's $1.20-$1.35B housing-revenue range and 16.0%-16.6% adjusted gross-margin guide.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Margin reaches the high end, orders stabilize and Q4 guidance confirms continued sequential recovery.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Incentives deepen, orders/backlog deteriorate and Q4 margin guidance slips.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 10.3% versus a 7.8% ten-year average; the prior report triggered a 16.7% relief rally.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus sits close to management's range midpoint, leaving the order and guide quality more important than headline EPS.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Three Lean Down calls; low disparity, but reversal risk stayed high.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic retail sales and gross margin
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Peak inflation and shipment timing pressure Q1, but improving retail trends and a recently reaffirmed annual outlook make the downside edge too weak.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $0.72 EPS and $4.34B revenue; FY27 guidance remains organic sales -1.5% to +0.5% and adjusted EPS $3.00-$3.20.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume/share gains and cost savings make Q1 less weak than feared while guidance holds.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: RBC's below-consensus margin view proves right and price investment fails to restore profitable volume.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 8.6%, well above the 5.2% ten-year average; the stock is down about 20% in 2026.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS consensus edged up 0.4% over 30 days, but RBC and UBS remained cautious on inflation and cost pressure.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All passes clustered near the Lean Down/Neutral boundary.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY27 adjusted EBITDA and commercial outlook
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cost savings and raised FY26 guidance are constructive, but the strong run and ownership, stadium and squad narratives overwhelm a clean earnings edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The decisive bar is forward EBITDA after FY26 revenue guidance rose to £655-£665M and adjusted EBITDA to £200-£210M; published EPS estimates conflict.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY27 commercial, matchday and broadcasting outlook extends the cost-led earnings improvement.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Cash/debt, squad spending or stadium funding offsets strong backward-looking EBITDA.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 14.9% versus a 6% ten-year average; positioning is event-heavy.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sell-side evidence is sparse and EPS estimates conflict, so EBITDA guidance carries more weight.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All passes were Neutral-to-Lean Up; high reversal risk was consistent.
